build_model_parallel_attention: build a ModelParallelMultiheadAttention module with specified embed_dim and num_heads for multi-GPU inference
create_self_attention_layer: create a self-attention layer by setting self_attention=True in ModelParallelMultiheadAttention constructor
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through ModelParallelMultiheadAttention with query, key, and value tensors
test_incremental_decoding: test incremental decoding by passing incremental_state dict to the forward method
review_xformers_attention: review the xformers memory efficient attention path when attn_variant is set to XFORMERS
